name: ERO Boston Massachusetts operation
text: ICE Boston 19 Oct 2026, as posted: Authorities arrested 82 illegal aliens during the three-day operation in southeastern Massachusetts the week of Sept. 21. 82 total, 7 named on their own rows, 75 unnamed counted here. Unnamed cluster, heads=75.

name: ICE gang-member arrests operation
text: ICE 20 Oct 2026, as posted: From October 4 to October 10, ICE arrested 131 gang-affiliated individuals, including 129 by ERO and 2 by HSI. 131 total, 3 named on their own rows, 128 unnamed counted here. Unnamed cluster, heads=128. Also posted: https://www.ice.gov/news/releases/ice-arrests-more-100-gang-members-less-week
